column1: # Pairs every constant stated in shipped prose (fenced pseudocode AND running text) against every
# numeric default in reference-impl/*.py, AND against every other statement of the same symbol.
#   numeric tokens inside those fences ....... 1304   (== register 1's fenced_code exclusion; the two registers reconcile)
#     IDENTITY: 151 assignments + 1153 excluded = 1304 == fenced tokens -> HOLDS
#     'number_is_a_citation_or_xref_token' reuses register 1's exclusion map verbatim, so the two
#     registers cannot disagree about what counts as a citation.
#     scanned over a 2-LINE WINDOW because this corpus hard-wraps: the dune `hop` docstring case
#     is split across two lines and a 1-line scan misses it. That is the exact defect class here.
#     Restricted to symbols that exist in module source (359 symbols), so a prose number next to an
#     unimplemented name is NOT a row — that residue is a known gap, logged in OPEN-ITEMS.md.
#   distinct symbols carrying a numeric default/const .... 298
#   distinct symbols carrying a docstring-stated value ... 98
#   symbols never mentioned in prose (module_only rows) .. 514
# VERDICTS: module_only=514, chapter_vs_chapter=159, chapter_only=98, diverge=81, agree=32
#   diverge            chapter value != module value  <-- the defect class
#   chapter_only       prose states a constant for a symbol no module defines
#   module_only        module ships a default no prose ever states
#   chapter_vs_chapter the SAME symbol is given two different values by two prose/docstring sites.
#                      Required because a chapter<->module-only table cannot see this class at all;
#                      dune `hop` is the worked instance (05:399 says 3, dunes.py:49 docstring says 5,
#                      dunes.py:20 ships 1 — a three-way split no pairwise chapter/module check finds).
#   CAVEAT, stated not hidden: 137 of the 159 chapter_vs_chapter rows involve a symbol of <=2 characters
#   (n, c, k, H ...). Single letters are reused across unrelated chapters, so many of those rows are
#   name collisions rather than real divergences. They are KEPT, not dropped: a freeze must not
#   silently discard candidates. Wave 1 downgrades them by assigning a verdict, not by deleting rows.
# FREEZE RULE: later waves may only change the verdict column. New pairs go to OPEN-ITEMS.md.
